title: Standby Charging Where Workplace Cafe Management Program Counter Service Stands Paused
content:
### The situation the charge answers to
Counter service at a client's site stands paused from time to time under an approved suspension on the Workplace Cafe Management Program contract held for that site. A pause of that kind carries a standby charge for the period the counter stood closed, and that charge is recorded against the billing period in which it is raised. Once it is raised, the workplace experience manager sees the standby charge standing on the contract and a larger unsettled balance to settle.

### What the function can prove
`post_standby_charge_21704194` raises the standby charge on a workplace cafe management contract for a period in which counter service stood paused. One call books a contractual charge of the amount given onto that contract's ledger under the standby charge subtype, dates it the day of the call, records it against the billing period named, gives it its own printed invoice number and raises the contract's unsettled invoice balance by the same amount.

### How it is invoked
The client services desk has `post_standby_charge_21704194` unlocked to it and runs the call against the contract concerned.

### Parameters
- `cafe_contract_id` is the reference number of the workplace cafe management contract the standby charge is raised on; it is returned by the cafe contract lookup for the client.
- `standby_charge_usd` is the standby charge being raised for the paused service, in USD, written as a decimal number to 2 decimal places; it is stored to 2 decimal places exactly as given and must be a positive amount.
- `service_period` is the billing period the standby charge is recorded against, written as a calendar month in the form YYYY-MM with no day part.

### What comes back
A single confirmation sentence in plain text naming the contract reference charged, the standby charge in USD to 2 decimal places, the billing period it was recorded against, the posting day as YYYY-MM-DD, the printed invoice number of the new posting in the form INV-CF- followed by 6 digits, and the contract's unsettled invoice balance in USD to 2 decimal places after the charge. Receiving that sentence is what shows the charge stands.
